propositions: On bug close, auto-derive a caused_by link to a culprit commit via git blame, provided the pre-fix state has a strict majority (>50%) of blamed lines pointing to one commit that resolves to a ticket via rebar-ticket: trailer.
The --caused-by <id> CLI parameter overrides auto-derivation and explicitly sets the caused_by link at close time.
The auto-link must be written via _write_link_event directly to bypass the closed-source guard, since the bug is already closed when auto-derivation runs after txn.transition_core commits.
Auto-derivation returns None (no link) on ambiguity: missing file_impact, no fixing commit found, no >50% dominant commit, or no resolvable ticket trailer — and never blocks the close.
The caused_by parameter must be threaded through transition(), transition_compute, and close_ticket so both CLI and library callers can set it on bug close.
Bug-template shall include a blame-hunt advisory explaining when auto-derivation applies and when to use --caused-by explicitly.
